scope: Public primary-source research. No subscriptions, purchases, builds, native tests, or live changes.
date_note: Steam metadata without a year is interpreted in current2026; exact display dates included in prior tool evidence.
native_existing: Jana50 native moped already in build; do not relabel as a new Workshop mod
Bitrak native dirtbike already in build
integration_requirements: Load selected mods and actual required dependencies on server/client using normal Steam paths; copy signing keys. Never redistribute restricted PBOs.
Read bundled publisher serverfiles and compare exact classes against loaded CfgVehicles before writing events. Do not infer classnames from titles.
Combine existing economy fragments using XML parser, not header concatenation.
Add Avalon-specific clear drivable spawn positions; do not import Chernarus coordinate samples.
Spawn counts, attachments, fuel/battery service and persistence must be verified per vehicle. Server startup and one native movement/rejoin test per new family before calling ready.

Wrap eligibility is separate: audit body/attachment hidden selections, server-selectedID/clientID/per-slot material and texture readback; exclude glass/rubber/lights. Native screenshot test is still required.
unresolved: No author-verified electric bicycle addition located in current search; do not invent one.
GolfCart and Vespa exact classes exist only in downloaded serverfiles at present.
None of these vehicles has been natively tested by this agent.
Vespa and Tech terms restrict modifications; stock transport enablement does not establish permission for custom wraps.
